mentions.name: Ziago
mentions.description: A realtime social gaming and quiz platform built to get people socialising and connecting, originally created during Covid and now being rebuilt with Convex; it has grown steadily to 380k total users.
mentions.problem: Helping people socialise and connect more with each other.
mentions.audience: 380,000 total users; a general audience of people looking to socialise and connect through games and quizzes
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding my Covid-era realtime social gaming/quiz platform. It’s been steadily growing over past few years (380k people total).
mentions.author: Pietbull
